caseName: General Motors Corp. v. United States
caseNameFull: General Motors Corp. v. United States
attorneys: Messrs. John Thomas Smith, Ernest S. Ballard, and Herbert Pope for petitioners. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Arnold, and Mr. Robert L. Stern for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Murphy, and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
